title: Safe Usage of Park Connector Networks by Cyclists and PMD Riders
what_it_is: Safe Usage of Park Connector Networks by Cyclists and PMD Riders

sections.label: PCN lane marking pilot
sections.summary: Lane markings on 30 km of the Park Connector Network pilot separate slower pedestrians from faster bicycles and mobility devices.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The lane markings that the Member speaks about are part of a pilot project started by the National Parks Board (NParks) in 2018 to try to guide slower pedestrians away from faster bicycles, personal mobility devices (PMDs) and so on.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: This pilot was tried out on 30 kilometres (km) of the Park Connector Network (PCN) out of an entire network of some 330 km.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For the lane on the left marked with the pedestrian sign, the intent was for this to be used primarily by pedestrians and other people who are moving more slowly, for example, on wheelchairs or assisted mobility devices.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For the lane on the right marked with "PCN", the intent was for this to be used primarily by faster traffic, such as bicycles, PMDs and other mobility devices.

sections.label: PCN enforcement and safety measures
sections.summary: NParks and LTA conduct joint enforcement against errant PCN users, and NParks adds separated paths, lighting, speed strips and signs.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For hotspot areas, NParks works with the Land Transport Authority (LTA) to conduct joint enforcement efforts against errant PCN users who exceed speed limits or ride recklessly.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In areas where there is sufficient space, and here, I am talking about sufficient width of the PCN, NParks will work towards having physically separated paths for the different user groups.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To further ensure the safe usage of PCNs, NParks will continue to introduce safety measures, such as additional lighting, speed regulating strips and advisory signs at high usage areas.

sections.label: NParks enforcement against reckless behaviour
sections.summary: NParks enforces, like LTA, against reckless behaviour and speeding.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: NParks does enforce, like LTA, against reckless behaviour and speeding.
